body:
Given that

A) people are using [kludges](https://github.com/single-spa/import-map-injector?tab=readme-ov-file#import-map-injector) to [work around](https://lea.verou.me/blog/2026/external-import-maps-today/) this limitation (which are almost certainly slower than proper support would be)

B) The reason for the current lack of implementation seems to [boil down to](https://github.com/WICG/import-maps/issues/235#issuecomment-943728519) "we didn't get around to it".

C) Trying to use `<script type=importmap>` with an `src` attribute is a very obvious thing that, given what people know about script tags, developers are going to try to do and then be confused when it doesn't work.

D) There's real practical uses for this, since inlining these, with properly relative URLs, is annoying to do in many types of setups.

... I'd argue that this would really be worth giving attention to. Especially if one major browser already supports it.
